title: Xero Developer Platform
snippet:
- ### Start Building
Sign up for a free account to build on the Xero platform. Take a look at our getting started guide, SDKs and the other steps you need to complete for certification.
[Steps to becoming an app partner](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/xero-app-store/app-partner-guides/grow-your-app-with-xero/)
- ### Get Certified
Find customers who love your app, you'll need ten to get certified. See our certification checkpoints and best practices for more details.
[Review the certification checkpoints](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api-guides/certification-checkpoints)
- ### Publish your App on the Xero App Store
Publish your app on the Xero App Store for access to over 4 million small business customers and 200,000+ accountants and bookkeepers.
[Create an Xero App Store listing](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/xero-app-store/app-partner-guides/app-listing)

On 4-December we announced new pricing. Accountants and Bookkepers are exempt from this new pricing model.

- ### Sign up as a development partner
If you’ve got proven experience building custom integrations with the Xero API, then register to become a developer partner.

title: apideck.com/blog/how-to-get-xero-api-key
snippet:
* Developer account (free, takes 30 seconds to create)
## Step 1: Create a Xero Developer Account
Go to https://developer.xero.com and sign up. Use the same email address as your Xero account to avoid confusion later.
## Step 2: Create Your App
Hit **MyApps → New app**
Fill this out:
- App name: Something you'll recognize in 6 months
- Company or application URL: Your website (or use http://localhost for testing)
- OAuth 2.0 redirect URI: Where Xero sends users after auth
- Testing: http://localhost:8080/callback
- Production: https://yourapp.com/auth/xero/callback

Apps created from March 2, 2026 can't use the old broad `accounting.transactions` scope. Xero split it into granular scopes, and older apps have to switch by September 13, 2027. The ones you'll likely need:
- accounting.invoices: Invoices, credit notes, and items
- accounting.payments: Payments
- accounting.banktransactions: Bank transactions
- accounting.manualjournals: Manual journals
- accounting.contacts: Customer and supplier data
- accounting.settings: Company info, chart of accounts, tax rates
- offline_access: Gives you a refresh token, so you can get new access tokens without sending the user back through login
For new apps, the balance sheet, profit and loss, and journals scopes aren't available on standard apps. They need Xero App Partner Program enrolment.

**Rate Limits**:
* Minute limit: 60 calls per organization
* Concurrent limit: 5 calls per organization
* Daily limit: 5,000 calls per organization (1,000 on Xero's free Starter tier)

Connection limits depend on your Xero developer pricing tier. The free Starter tier allows up to 5 connections, Core up to 50, and from Plus (51+ connections) upward you need App Partner certification. Until you're certified, each Xero organization can connect at most 2 uncertified apps.

If you later certify as a Xero App Partner, you'll need a custom Vault domain first so the Apideck callback is hidden.

title: How Xero Developer changes affect your practice
snippet:
From 2 March 2026, Xero Developer is changing from a revenue-share model to a tiered usage-based pricing model. Pricing will largely be based on the number of Xero customers connected to an app and the amount of data the app extracts from Xero.
To support innovation in our app ecosystem, the entry-level Starter tier will remain free. This keeps barriers to entry low so developers and startups can continue to build new solutions for practices.

To support the responsible use of your practice’s and your clients’ data, we’ve updated our developer policies to limit how data obtained via Xero’s APIs can be used.
These policies came into effect for new apps from 4 December 2025 and will come into effect for existing apps from 2 March 2026.
With these updated policies, Xero developers can no longer:
- Use data obtained through Xero’s APIs to train AI models
- Use bots or browser extensions to undermine Xero’s security controls or simulate user actions
Find out more about how these policy changes affect data use on [Xero Developer](https://developer.xero.com/pricing#xero-developer-platform-terms-and-conditions-including-the-associated-commercial-terms).

In addition to the custom integrations built specifically for your practice or single client use, many tools for managing practices and clients are excluded from the new pricing model. These include:
- Data conversion apps
- Financial services apps including bank feeds, credit integrations and third-party payment partnerships

- **Manual Journals endpoint (data in):** This endpoint is used to make adjustments in Xero. Most apps use this endpoint to push data into Xero, and this remains free.
- **Journals endpoint (data out):** This endpoint is used to extract the general ledger from Xero in bulk. This endpoint requires a security assessment and use-case review.
To better protect customer data, developers must complete a security assessment to access the practice management in Xero Partner Hub (previously Xero Practice Manager) API and the Journals endpoint for bulk extraction of data out of Xero. Accountants and bookkeepers can still access the Journals endpoint and the practice management API for free by completing the security assessment.

title: Xero API Pricing and the App Partner Program
snippet:
| Tier | Monthly Fee (USD) | Monthly Fee (AUD) | Monthly Fee (GBP) | Max Connections | Monthly Egress |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Starter** | $0 | $0 | £0 | 5 | Unlimited |
| **Core** | ~$22 | $35 | ~£18 | 50 | 10 GB |
| **Plus** | ~$152 | $245 | ~£125 | 1,000 | 50 GB |
| **Advanced** | ~$895 | $1,445 | ~£735 | 10,000 | 250 GB |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | Custom |

**Additional pricing details:**
- **Overage rate:** $2.40 AUD per GB (~$1.50 USD)
- **Daily API limit:** 5,000 calls per organization (1,000/org on Starter tier)
- **Tier prerequisites:** App Partner certification from Plus upward, an initial and annual security assessment from Advanced upward, and an App Store listing for Enterprise
- **AI training:** Xero's new terms don't allow data from its APIs to be used to train AI or machine learning models
For US-based developers, the Advanced tier translates to approximately **$895 USD/month** or **$10,740 USD annually**.
### Key pricing mechanics
**Connections** represent unique Xero organizations linked to your app via OAuth. Each customer authorizing your app counts as one connection. Pricing is measured at the app level—separate apps cannot share connection counts.
**Data egress** measures gigabytes downloaded from Xero's APIs monthly. All GET requests count toward your allowance, with one exception: the Organisation endpoint is excluded, recognizing its common use as a connectivity check.
**Data ingress** (uploads to Xero) remains **unlimited and free** at all tiers—only data pulled from Xero counts against your allowance.
### Premium features locked behind Advanced tier
Three capabilities require the $895/month (USD) Advanced tier minimum:
- **Journals endpoint**: Full double-entry bookkeeping data for balance sheet reconciliation and advanced reporting
- **Xero Practice Manager (XPM) API**: Integration with Xero's practice management system for accountants
- **Bulk Connections**: Connect multiple Xero organizations in a single OAuth flow
On top of the tier, all three need a security assessment and use case approval from Xero.

### MYOB (Australia-focused)
MYOB uses flat subscription pricing without per-call charges:
| Tier | Monthly Fee | Features |
|---|---|---|
| Developer Access | $110 AUD | Basic API access |
| DeveloperPartner | $220 AUD | Enhanced features |
| Premium DeveloperPartner | $630 AUD | Full access |
**Advantage:** Predictable costs regardless of API usage volume.
**Disadvantage:** Higher basel

title: Xero Developer Frequently asked questions — Xero Developer
snippet:
The Xero API does not support basic API Key authentication. Our API uses OAuth 2.0 which means you need to [register your app](https://developer.xero.com/app/manage/) to get a client id and client secret which you use to access the API.

Apps using the API have the access of a Standard or Advisor role user and:
- To access Reporting APIs the authorising user must have Reports access.
- To access the /ManualJournals and /Journals endpoints of the Accounting API, the authorising user must have Reports access.
- To access Payroll APIs the authorising user must be a Payroll Admin.

| Feature | Starter | Core | Plus | Advanced | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connections (maximum) | 5 | 50 | 1000 | 10,000 | No limit |
| Monthly Tier Fee | No charge | $35 AUD | $245 AUD | $1445 AUD | Price on Application |

| Overage Xero API usage egress pricing (per GB) | n/a | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | Price on Application |
Pricing is tax exclusive

### What are the rate limits?
Rate limits are the same as Xero APIs. Today that's 1,000 calls per day per organisation on the Starter plan and 5,000 per day per organisation on the Core plan and above, per the [pricing page](https://developer.xero.com/pricing).

The API can be used with all Xero plans, but not all features will necessarily be available. Payroll API requires a Payroll plan. Cashbook and Ledger plans exclude certain features (e.g. invoicing) but can still be connected to via the API.
